Coram : S. ABDUL NAZEER*, J.K. MAHESHWARI
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988: Liability of Vehicle Owner – Accident Claim – Determination of Compensation – Victim-deceased was 24 years old and working as Managing Director at DRV Drinks Pvt. Ltd. – While he was returning from factory to residence, his car was hit from behind –The deceased sustained severe injuries and died on the way to hospital – Claim petition – MACT awarded a total sum of Rs. 31,90,000/- alongwith 7% interest – MACT held that the vehicle was not being operated as per the terms of permit and was in violation of terms
Decision Date : 15-12-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9322/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Direction Issue : Appeal dismissed and directions issued. | Bench : 2 Judges
